title: Purchase-Volume Relief on Refund-Without-Return Reversals
content:
**Purchase volume.** Under the refund-without-return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the member's purchasing volume adds to the relief fraction of the reversal. The volume is the total of the net amounts — the amounts charged after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount — of the lines on the member's Northgate orders on Northgate Store and Online Orders dated within the twelve whole calendar months before today (dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by today).

| Total net amount (USD) | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 0.1 |
| 2000 to less than 5000 | 0.05 |
| less than 2000 | nothing |

**Threshold pairs (hypothetical totals).** 5000.00 adds 0.1 while 4999.99 adds 0.05; 2000.00 adds 0.05 while 1999.99 adds nothing.
